import sys, json, re, random, hashlib, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from ets_sim import *

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT=ROOT/'docs/research/ets-2026-11-12'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
PROMPT=(ROOT/'docs/architecture/review-2026-11/pro/12-ets-prompt.md').read_text()

def save(name,obj):
    (OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')

def history(h):
    match=re.search(r'^H'+str(h)+r' n=\d+ y16=(\[[^\n]+?\])',PROMPT,re.M)
    return [v/16. for v in json.loads(match[1])]

def seasonal_cases():
    section=PROMPT.split('(b) The refused seasonal cells')[1].split('The r38 base series')[0]
    cases=[]
    for i,match in enumerate(re.finditer(r'y=\{([^}]+)\} target=(\d+) period=(\d+) FC=\[\x27([^\x27]+)\x27\] CI=\[\x27([^\x27]+)\x27\]',section)):
        y=[float(v) for v in match[1].split(';')]
        if len(y)<8: continue
        cases.append(dict(id='C'+str(len(cases)+1),y=y,p=int(match[3]),known_f1=float(match[4]),known_c1=float(match[5])))
    assert len(cases)==9
    return cases

def question(id,y,p,output,index,predictions):
    return dict(id=id,y=y,p=p,output=output,index=index,predictions=predictions)

def freeze_initial():
    # These are offline checks against printed evidence, before any service use.
    y=history(74); f=fit(y)
    assert bits(f['stats'][3])==bits(.506107176967325)
    assert f['a']==.75
    y=history(90); f=fit(y)
    assert bits(forecast(y,f,2))=='402980010432c2f4'
    assert bits(forecast(y,f,3))=='402cbb4568573e06'
    assert bits(ci(y,f,1))==bits(.4073914833743825)
    rows=[]
    t0=list(map(float,range(10000,20000,1000)))+[20011.,20991.]
    t1=list(map(float,range(1000000,2200000,100000)))
    t1[7]+=2000; t1[8]+=26170; t1[9]-=19550
    tm=t1.copy(); tm[10]-=11; tm[11]+=9
    tp=t1.copy(); tp[10]+=11; tp[11]-=9
    t2=[1000000.,1100000.,1200000.,1300000.,1400000.,1500000.,1600000.,1702000.,270261626.,-534990462.,270435456.,2100000.]
    for scale in [-100,0,100]:
        y=[math.ldexp(v,scale) for v in t0]
        for stat in [1,2]:
            rows.append(question(f'T0_{scale}_S{stat}',y,0,'stat',stat,{
              'first_retained_23':val([.9,.001][stat-1]),
              'last_retained_23':val([.998,.899][stat-1]),
              'last_retained_25':val([.998,.249][stat-1])}))
    for name,y in [('T1',t1),('T1plus',tp),('T1minus',tm),('T2',t2)]:
        ff=fit(y); fl=fit(y,last=True)
        fp=fit(y,score_kind='pc64'); fw=fit(y,score_kind='wide_sum')
        extra=fit(y,pool=PARAMETERS+[(.833333,.001)])
        for stat in [1,2]:
            field='a' if stat==1 else 'b'
            rows.append(question(f'{name}_S{stat}',y,0,'stat',stat,{
              'first_double':val(ff[field]),'last_double':val(fl[field]),
              'first_pc64':val(fp[field]),'first_wide_sum':val(fw[field]),
              'extra_833333_floor':val(extra[field])}))
    y=[math.ldexp(v,-600) for v in tm]
    rows.append(question('T1minus_m600_S1',y,0,'stat',1,{
       'binary64_squares_underflow':val(.9),'normalized_or_extended_score':val(.75)}))
    save('ties-predictions.json',dict(protocol='Frozen before Excel; direct comparisons of candidate SSE; see model.json.',rows=rows))
    rows=[]
    rng=random.Random(633209)
    short=[(f'H{h}',history(h)) for h in range(87,101)]
    short += [(f'fresh_n{n}_{k}',[rng.randint(-300,300)/16. for _ in range(n)]) for n in range(4,8) for k in range(5)]
    short += [('H22',history(22))]
    for name,y in short:
        f=fit(y)
        for h in [2,3]:
            rows.append(question(f'{name}_F{h}',y,0,'forecast',h,{'landed_program':val(forecast(y,f,h))}))
        rows.append(question(f'{name}_Cendpoint',y,0,'endpoint',1,{'landed_program':val(ci(y,f,1)),'equals_stat7':val(f['stats'][3])}))
        for stat in [1,2,7]:
            value=f['a'] if stat==1 else f['b'] if stat==2 else f['stats'][3]
            rows.append(question(f'{name}_S{stat}',y,0,'stat',stat,{'landed_program':val(value)}))
    save('short-predictions.json',dict(seed=633209,confidence_bits='3fefffffffffffff',rows=rows))
    rows=[]
    patterns=[([0.,3.,9.],n) for n in [6,7,9]]+[([0.,4.,12.,24.],9),([0.,5.,10.,20.,35.],10)]
    for k,(pattern,n) in enumerate(patterns):
        p=len(pattern); y=[pattern[j%p] for j in range(n)]
        f=fit(y)
        for stat in [3,1]:
            preds={}
            for name,admit in [('C1_partial',True),('C2_complete',n%p==0),('C3_three_cycles',p in [2,4,8] or n>=3*p)]:
                preds[name]=val((.001 if stat==3 else .751) if admit else (EPS if stat==3 else f['a']))
            rows.append(question(f'cycle_p{p}_n{n}_S{stat}',y,p,'stat',stat,preds))
    for d in [1/16.,1.,16.]:
        y=[0.,8.,0.,8.,0.,8.,0.,8.+d]
        for stat,value in [(1,.751),(3,.001),(6,d/8.),(7,math.sqrt(d*d/8.))]:
            rows.append(question(f'S0_d{d}_S{stat}',y,2,'stat',stat,{'prefix_SSE_default':val(value)}))
    cases=seasonal_cases()
    b5=dict(id='B5',y=[float(256*j+(48 if j==8 else 0)) for j in range(12)],p=4)
    for case in cases+[b5]:
        y,p=case['y'],case['p']
        fits={kind:seasonal_fit(y,p,.751,.001,.001,kind) for kind in ['prefix','phase_mean','phase_regression']}
        for stat in range(1,8):
            preds={}
            for kind,f in fits.items():
                value=[f['a'],f['b'],f['g']][stat-1] if stat<=3 else f['stats'][stat-4]
                preds['default_'+kind]=val(value)
            rows.append(question(f"{case['id']}_S{stat}",y,p,'stat',stat,preds))
    save('seasonal-stage1-predictions.json',dict(
      protocol='Default-gain predictions are explicitly joint initializer+gain hypotheses, not claimed search winners. After reported gains, freeze conditional forecast predictions before further Excel calls.',
      cases=cases+[b5],rows=rows))
    save('model.json',dict(role='Clean-room black-box researcher; tiers 1 and repository own code only; no Microsoft implementation or disassembly.',
      source_pin=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
      sources=['crates/calc-func/src/catalogue/statistics/ets.rs','docs/architecture/review-2026-11/pro/12-ets-answer.md','docs/architecture/review-2026-11/pro/harvest/12-harvest.md'],
      python_source=(ROOT/'work/ets_sim.py').read_text(),
      generator_source=Path(__file__).read_text()))
    print('Frozen',[(p.name,len(json.loads(p.read_text()).get('rows',[]))) for p in OUT.glob('*predictions.json')])

def ask(name):
    # Refuse to send uncommitted predictions.
    rel='docs/research/ets-2026-11-12/'+name+'-predictions.json'
    subprocess.run(['git','diff','--exit-code','HEAD','--',rel],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','--error-unmatch',rel],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    data=json.loads((OUT/(name+'-predictions.json')).read_text())
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools/excel-service'))
    from client import Client, number, number_array
    client=Client()
    groups={}
    for q in data['rows']:
        y=q['y']; n=len(y)
        ya=number_array([y]); ta=number_array([list(map(float,range(1,n+1)))])
        if q['output']=='stat':
            function='FORECAST.ETS.STAT'; args=[ya,ta,number(q['index']),number(q['p'])]
        elif q['output']=='forecast':
            function='FORECAST.ETS'; args=[number(n+q['index']),ya,ta,number(q['p'])]
        elif q['output'] in ['endpoint','confidence']:
            function='FORECAST.ETS.CONFINT'
            conf='3fefffffffffffff' if q['output']=='endpoint' else .95
            args=[number(n+q['index']),ya,ta,number(conf),number(q['p'])]
        else: raise ValueError(q)
        groups.setdefault(function,[]).append((q,args))
    requests=[(function,[args for _,args in qs]) for function,qs in groups.items()]
    replies=client.ask_many(requests,echo_inputs=True)
    answers=[]; envs=[]
    for (function,qs),reply in zip(groups.items(),replies):
        assert len(reply['rows'])==len(qs)
        envs.append({k:v for k,v in reply.items() if k!='rows' and k!='inputs'})
        for (q,args),answer in zip(qs,reply['rows']):
            answers.append(dict(id=q['id'],answer=answer,matches={k:v['bits']==answer.get('bits') for k,v in q['predictions'].items()}))
    save(name+'-answers.json',dict(predictions_sha256=hashlib.sha256((OUT/(name+'-predictions.json')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        prediction_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),environments=envs,rows=answers))
    print(name,len(answers),'answers')
    for a in answers:
        if not any(a['matches'].values()): print(a['id'],a['answer'])

def decoded(name):
    return {a['id']:struct.unpack('>d',bytes.fromhex(a['answer']['bits']))[0]
      for a in json.loads((OUT/(name+'-answers.json')).read_text())['rows']}

def freeze_stage2():
    observed=decoded('seasonal-stage1')
    rows=[]; details=[]
    cases=seasonal_cases()+[dict(id='B5',y=[float(256*j+(48 if j==8 else 0)) for j in range(12)],p=4)]
    for c in cases:
        y,p=c['y'],c['p']; name=c['id']
        a,b,g=[observed[name+'_S'+str(k)] for k in range(1,4)]
        fits={kind:seasonal_fit(y,p,a,b,g,kind) for kind in ['prefix','phase_mean','phase_regression']}
        details.append(dict(id=name,reported_gains=[a,b,g],initials={k:f['initial'] for k,f in fits.items()},
          existing_f1=c.get('known_f1'),existing_c1=c.get('known_c1'),
          predicted_stats={k:[val(v) for v in f['stats']] for k,f in fits.items()}))
        horizons=range(1,p+2) if name=='B5' else range(2,p+2)
        for h in horizons:
            rows.append(question(name+f'_F{h}',y,p,'forecast',h,{k:val(forecast(y,f,h)) for k,f in fits.items()}))
        if name!='B5':
            for h in [p,p+1]:
                rows.append(question(name+f'_C{h}',y,p,'confidence',h,
                   {k:val(ci(y,f,h,1.9599639845400536)) for k,f in fits.items()}))
        # Fresh full RMS controls and 95% C1, including B5.
        for output,z in [('endpoint',1.),('confidence',1.9599639845400536)]:
            rows.append(question(name+('_Cendpoint' if output=='endpoint' else '_C1'),y,p,output,1,
              {k:val(ci(y,f,1,z)) for k,f in fits.items()}))
    # S0 gained observations; the prefix initialization hypotheses predict conditional
    # states/gains and fresh forecasts without needing an unmeasured search model.
    for d in [1/16.,1.,16.]:
        y=[0.,8.,0.,8.,0.,8.,0.,8.+d]
        a=observed[f'S0_d{d}_S1']; g=observed[f'S0_d{d}_S3']; b=.001
        fits={kind:seasonal_fit(y,2,a,b,g,kind) for kind in ['prefix','phase_mean','phase_regression']}
        for h in [1,2,3]:
            rows.append(question(f'S0_d{d}_F{h}',y,2,'forecast',h,{k:val(forecast(y,f,h)) for k,f in fits.items()}))
        rows.append(question(f'S0_d{d}_Cendpoint',y,2,'endpoint',1,{k:val(ci(y,f,1)) for k,f in fits.items()}))
        rows.append(question(f'S0_d{d}_S2',y,2,'stat',2,{'no_reset_or_floor':val(.001)}))
    # Quantify the forecast/zero-error consequence of the cycle admission observations.
    patterns=[([0.,3.,9.],n) for n in [6,7,9]]+[([0.,4.,12.,24.],9),([0.,5.,10.,20.,35.],10)]
    for pat,n in patterns:
        p=len(pat); y=[pat[j%p] for j in range(n)]
        f=seasonal_fit(y,p,.751,.001,.001,'prefix')
        for h in range(1,p+2):
            rows.append(question(f'cycle_p{p}_n{n}_F{h}',y,p,'forecast',h,{'admitted_exact_seasonal':val(forecast(y,f,h))}))
        for stat in [4,5,6,7]:
            rows.append(question(f'cycle_p{p}_n{n}_S{stat}',y,p,'stat',stat,{'admitted_exact_seasonal':val(0.)}))
        rows.append(question(f'cycle_p{p}_n{n}_Cendpoint',y,p,'endpoint',1,{'admitted_exact_seasonal':val(0.)}))
    save('seasonal-stage2-predictions.json',dict(
      protocol='Frozen after observed STATs, before this forecast/CI batch. Treat reported beta as recurrence beta and assume no reset; all forward states use the same innovations recurrence. 95% z is measured 1.9599639845400536; endpoint z=1. No fit to future outputs.',
      covariance_relations={c['id']:{'innovation':val((observed[c['id']+'_S1']+c['p']*observed[c['id']+'_S2']+observed[c['id']+'_S3'])**2),
      'traditional':val((observed[c['id']+'_S1']+c['p']*observed[c['id']+'_S2']+(1.-observed[c['id']+'_S1'])*observed[c['id']+'_S3'])**2)} for c in cases if c['id']!='B5'},
      conditional_models=details,rows=rows))
    print('Frozen seasonal stage2',len(rows),'readings')

if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1]=='freeze': freeze_initial()
    elif sys.argv[1]=='ask': ask(sys.argv[2])
    elif sys.argv[1]=='stage2': freeze_stage2()
